_comment: PREPARED, NOT APPLIED. The ONLY policy this role gets. Substitute <BUCKET>. IT IS PUT-ONLY AND THAT IS THE POINT: no GetObject, no DeleteObject, no DeleteObjectVersion, no ListBucket, and no wildcard on either Action or Resource. A recorder writes evidence and never reads it back, never removes it, and never needs to know what else is there. A credential that can delete the archive is a credential that can quietly rewrite history, which is the one property this archive exists to deny. Overwrite protection does NOT come from this policy, because S3 has no create-if-absent condition: it comes from Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode plus versioning, set on the bucket in RUNBOOK.md step 4.1. Deletion of an old version is denied explicitly below as a second line of defence, so a widened policy elsewhere cannot silently grant it. See scripts/s3-archive/RUNBOOK.md.
